entries.scope: Undici 6.29.0 bundled inside npm 12.2.1, used only by release tooling and never shipped with the Home Assistant integration
entries.reason: Owner-approved temporary acceptance of GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c on 2026-10-24, explicitly extended on 2026-10-30 to GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx and GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm for the 6.1.1 hotfix. Current npm releases still bundle undici 6.29.0, which project overrides cannot replace. Only these advisory IDs at this exact release-tooling path are accepted through the unchanged expiry; other advisories and paths remain blocking
